# Mailbox Plus
> Pack & ship, printing, mailbox rentals, and business services in Concord Township, Ohio.
> UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL at one counter. Compare rates before you ship.

## Business Info

- **Business Name:** Mailbox Plus
- **Tagline:** Shipping shouldn't cost you an hour.
- **Location:** 7554 Fredle Drive, Concord Township, OH 44077

- **Social:** Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/mailboxplusohio), Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/mailboxplusohio), Nextdoor (https://nextdoor.com/pages/mailbox-plus-concord-township-oh)

## What Makes Mailbox Plus Different

- **Multi-carrier comparison:** We quote UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL side-by-side at one counter. You pick the cheapest or fastest. Franchises (UPS Store, FedEx Office) can only sell one carrier.
- **All 4 carriers under one roof:** Authorized FedEx ShipCenter, UPS Authorized Shipper Outlet, USPS provider, and DHL Service Point.
- **Professional packing:** Double-wall boxes, 2-inch acrylic tape, multi-layer bubble wrap, custom foam inserts. Not newspaper. Not hope.
- **Free package drop-offs:** Bring any pre-labeled package from any carrier. No charge. Receipt provided.
- **Declared-value insurance:** Third-party insurance through Marsh for items worth more than the carrier's $100 default liability.
- **Porch theft protection:** Private mailbox means packages go to our counter, not your doorstep. We sign for all deliveries from all carriers.
- **Walk-in notary:** $5 per signature. No appointment needed. Certified notary on staff during all business hours.

## Services — Pack & Ship

### Carrier Services
We offer all four major carriers at one counter. We weigh your package, show you rates from each carrier side-by-side, and you choose.

- **FedEx Shipping** — Express, Ground, Home Delivery, International. Authorized ShipCenter.
- **UPS Shipping** — Ground, Next Day Air, 2nd Day Air, International. Authorized Shipper Outlet.
- **USPS Services** — Priority Mail, First-Class, Media Mail, Certified Mail, International postage.
- **DHL Express** — International time-definite shipping worldwide.

### Specialty Shipping
We custom-pack and ship items that don't fit standard boxes:
- **Artwork & Collectibles** — Custom crating, acid-free archival materials, double-wall boxes, full insurance. We ship paintings up to 48"x60".
- **Bicycles** — Reinforced bike boxes, axle guards, partial disassembly, foam wrap. Ships via UPS or FedEx Ground.
- **Golf Clubs** — Purpose-built golf club boxes, club head protection.

### Packing & Supplies
- **Professional Packing** — Multi-layer bubble wrap, custom foam inserts, double-walled boxes, suspension packing. Minimum 2 inches of padding on all sides.
- **Custom Box Making** — Heavy-duty boxes built to your item's exact dimensions. Reinforced corners, foam inserts. Most built while you wait or within 24 hours.
- **Packaging Supplies** — Boxes, bubble wrap, tape, foam peanuts, tubes, poly mailers — all carrier-grade quality for UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL.

### Drop-Off & Receiving
- **Free Package Drop-Offs** — Bring any pre-labeled UPS, FedEx, USPS, or DHL package. We scan, receipt, and hand to the carrier. No charge.
- **Package Receiving** — We sign for and store packages from all 4 carriers. $10/one-time or included with mailbox rental. Notification within 4 hours.

### Postage & Stamps
- USPS Forever Stamps, international postage, stamp books, metered mail available at the counter.

### Returns
- **Amazon Returns** — We scan QR codes, print labels on adhesive paper, pack items, and drop off. In and out in under 60 seconds for QR code returns.
- **FedEx Easy Returns** — QR code returns, no box or label needed, 60-second drop-off.
- **Nuuly Returns** — Print label, pack, and drop off for Nuuly clothing rental returns.

## Services — Copy & Print

- **Business Cards** — Premium cardstock, matte or glossy finish, rounded corners. Design help included. Most orders ready in days.
- **Flyers & Brochures** — Full-color, custom sizes, premium stocks. Same-day turnaround on most jobs. No minimum quantity.
- **Posters & Banners** — Large-format, full-color, indoor/outdoor materials.
- **Postcards** — Direct mail ready, custom sizes, full-color both sides. EDDM-compatible.
- **Document Printing** — Color and B&W. Single or double-sided. Stapled, bound, or loose. From USB, email, or cloud. We review your file for alignment and margins before printing.
- **Copies** — Color and B&W, collated, stapled.
- **Graphic Design** — Custom logos, business cards, flyers, brochures, posters, full brand kits. We design and print — one stop.

## Services — Mailbox Rentals

A real street address (7554 Fredle Drive, PMB [Your Number], Concord Township, OH 44077). Not a PO Box. Accepts all 4 carriers.

- **Small Mailbox:** $35/month or $420/year
- **Large Mailbox:** $50/month or $600/year
- **Key Deposit:** $5 (refundable)
- **Package Overage:** $5 per additional package beyond plan limit
- **30-day risk-free trial.** Month-to-month, no annual contract. Cancel anytime.
- **Same-day activation** for personal accounts. Business accounts verified next business day.
- **Notification within 4 hours** of mail arrival.
- **Digital mailbox option:** Scan and forward, view mail online.
- **Mail forwarding:** Forward mail to any address, temporary or permanent.
- **Virtual mailbox:** Remote mail management for travelers and remote workers.

## Services — Document Services

- **Every Door Direct Mail (EDDM)** — Target specific USPS carrier routes in Lake County. We help with design, printing, and USPS paperwork. Cost-effective local marketing.
- **Fax Services** — Send and receive faxes. Local, domestic, international. Printed confirmation sheet included. No fax machine needed — we do it for you.
- **Document Scanning** — Digitize paper documents to PDF. Various resolutions and formats.
- **Secure Shredding** — On-site shredding. Drop off and we shred. Certificates of destruction available.

## Services — Notary & Specialty

- **Notary Services** — $5 per signature. Walk-in, no appointment needed. Certified notary on staff during all business hours. Two forms of ID required (one with photo).
- **Digital Fingerprinting** — FBI/BCI digital fingerprinting for employment, licensing, background checks, and volunteer screening.
- **Declared-Value Insurance** — Third-party insurance through Marsh for high-value shipments. Covers items over the carrier's default $100 liability. About $1–2 per $100 of declared value.

## Common Questions (FAQ)

- **What carriers do you accept?** UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL. All four at one counter.
- **Can I drop off a pre-labeled package for free?** Yes. Free drop-offs for all 4 carriers. Receipt provided.
- **Do I need a printer for a return label?** No. Show us the QR code or email on your phone. We print it on adhesive label paper for $1–2.
- **How much does packing cost?** $5–10 for typical items. Custom crating and fragile items may cost more.
- **Can I get a mailbox without a long-term contract?** Yes. Month-to-month. 30-day risk-free trial. Cancel anytime.
- **Do you accept Amazon returns?** Yes. QR code, label, or order number. We scan, print, pack, and drop off.
- **What ID do I need for notary?** Two forms of ID, one with a photo (driver's license, passport).
- **Can I ship a bike?** Yes. We partially disassemble, box in a reinforced bike box, and ship via UPS or FedEx Ground.
- **Do you offer insurance for valuable shipments?** Yes. Declared-value insurance through Marsh for items over $100.
- **Can I receive packages at a mailbox rental?** Yes. All 4 carriers deliver to our address. We sign for everything.

## Competitor Alternatives

Mailbox Plus is a direct alternative to these national chains, offering the same services PLUS multi-carrier comparison:

- **UPS Store Alternative** — Same UPS services, but we also compare FedEx, USPS, and DHL rates.
- **FedEx Office Alternative** — FedEx shipping + printing, plus multi-carrier comparison.
- **Post Office Alternative** — USPS services without the wait, plus other carriers.
- **Staples Printing Alternative** — We print for you. No self-serve kiosks.
- **Office Depot Alternative** — Printing, shipping, business services at one counter.
- **Mail Boxes Etc Alternative** — Packing, shipping, mailbox rentals.
